title: 选择你的阵营
prompt: A dramatic cinematic scene featuring two rival products placed side by side in a custom-designed environment that visually reflects their identities. The composition should include high contrast lighting, atmospheric effects like mist, fog, or neon glow, and hyper-detailed textures. Incorporate a powerful 3D slogan below or behind the products in bold stylized typography that fits the scene’s mood. The products must reflect the essence of [Brand A] and [Brand B] through color, lighting, and placement. Ultra-realistic, moody tones, 1:1 square format, with sharp depth of field and high resolution.
description: 在霓虹光影与迷雾交织的戏剧化场景中，Nano Banana Pro与Nano Banana Pro通过高对比度画面与超细腻质感，打造出适合产品发布与科技视觉广告的沉浸式品牌展示。立体标语在氛围特效中强化视觉冲击，完美呈现对抗性产品的独特魅力。
